source: held perturbation pair of the unified cell (data/stageG4_clean); difference field fld_held - ctl_held, Al atoms
convention: pressure-positive (negative = tension); sign opposite to the LAMMPS virial
note: the field of the held ridge at the initial positions of the dislocation pair of the loaded cell is 5-10 MPa (opposite in sign to the on-axis value); where the upper partner comes to rest after its zero-stress drift (x ~ 84-87, z ~ 72, d ~ 32 A above the crest) the on-axis profile gives 13-14 MPa
